meta.name: sitemap-audit
meta.description: XML sitemap audit — find and fix the sitemap problems that quietly waste crawl budget and slow indexing. Discovers the sitemap (robots.txt, /sitemap.xml, sitemap index), validates structure and size limits, and cross-checks the URLs it lists against reality: non-200 / redirected / noindex / canonicalized-away URLs that shouldn't be in a sitemap, plus indexable pages that are missing from it. Reviews lastmod accuracy, sitemap-index organization, and robots.txt reference. Use this skill whenever the user asks about sitemaps, sitemap errors in Search Console, "sitemap couldn't fetch / has errors", crawl budget, pages not getting indexed, or whether their sitemap is clean. Trigger on: "sitemap", "sitemap.xml", "XML sitemap", "sitemap errors", "sitemap audit", "couldn't fetch sitemap", "crawl budget", "pages not indexed sitemap", "sitemap index", "lastmod", "robots.txt sitemap", or any sitemap/crawl-coverage question. For a full-site SEO audit use /seo-analysis; for broken links use /broken-link-checker.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 检查并修复网站地图问题，提升抓取效率
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站地图报错或页面迟迟不被收录
copy.tagline_en: Audit and fix sitemap issues to boost crawl efficiency
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your sitemap has errors or pages aren't getting indexed

howto.what: 该技能会找出网站的 sitemap 文件，检查其中每个网址是否有效、可被收录，并对比实际页面找出遗漏。它输出一份问题清单，标明哪些网址该删、哪些该加，以及结构上的修复建议。
howto.when: 当用户提到 sitemap、sitemap 报错、抓取预算等关键词时触发。

say.text: 帮我审计 https://example.com 的 sitemap
say.note: 技能会找到该站 sitemap 并检查其中的网址和结构。

say.text: 检查一下我的 sitemap 里有没有不该收录的页面
say.note: 它会列出非200、重定向、noindex 等有问题的网址。

say.text: 对比 sitemap 和实际页面，看看漏了哪些重要页面
say.note: 它会找出未被列出但应该收录的页面。

howto.what_en: This skill finds a site's sitemap files, checks each listed URL for validity and indexability, and compares against actual pages to spot missing ones. It outputs a list of URLs to remove or add, plus structural fixes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions sitemaps, sitemap errors, crawl budget, etc.

say_en.note: It discovers and checks the site's sitemap files.

say_en.text: Check my sitemap for URLs that shouldn't be in it
say_en.note: It flags non-200, redirects, noindex, etc.

say_en.text: Compare the sitemap with real pages and find missing ones
say_en.note: It lists indexable pages absent from the sitemap.
